parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source

acr
harbor
quay

acr
harbor
quay

parameters.name: region_ids

Data.description_en: The data returned when the operation is successful
Data.description_zh: 接口调用成功时，返回的数据

CanCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether more scan tasks can be created. Valid values:

true: More scan tasks can be created.
false: No more scan tasks can be created.

By default, up to 10 scan tasks can exist at the same time. If the number of scan tasks exceeds 10, creating a scan task by calling this operation fails. Wait until an existing scan task is completed before creating a new scan task
CanCreate.description_zh:
是否可以继续创建扫描任务。取值：

true：可以继续创建扫描任务。
false：无法继续创建扫描任务。

默认支持同时存在10个扫描任务，超过10个扫描任务时，使用本接口创建扫描任务会失败。您需要等待已有的10个扫描任务中有扫描任务完成后，才可以继续创建新的扫描任务

CollectTime.description_en: The timestamp when image information was collected, in milliseconds
CollectTime.description_zh: 采集镜像信息的时间戳，单位为毫秒

ExecTime.description_en: The timestamp when the scan task started running, in milliseconds
ExecTime.description_zh: 扫描任务开始运行的时间戳，单位为毫秒

FinishCount.description_en: The number of images that have been scanned
FinishCount.description_zh: 已完成扫描的镜像的数量

Progress.description_en: The progress percentage of the scan task
Progress.description_zh: 扫描任务进度的百分比

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the scan task. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The scan task succeeded.
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION: The image is in a region that does not support scanning.

For the regions that support image security scanning, see the table of supported regions after the response parameters table in this topic
Result.description_zh:
扫描任务的执行结果。取值：

SUCCESS：扫描任务执行成功。
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION：镜像在不支持扫描的地域。

镜像安全扫描支持的地域，请参见本文档返回参数表后的镜像安全扫描支持的地域的表格

Status.description_en:
The status of the scan task. Valid values:

INIT: Initializing.
PRE_ANALYZER: Pre-analyzing.
SUCCESS: Succeeded.
FAIL: Failed
Status.description_zh:
扫描任务的状态。取值：

INIT：初始化中。
PRE_ANALYZER：预分析中。
SUCCESS：执行成功。
FAIL：执行失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the scan task

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of images to scan

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
